routes.reason: A three-sheet translation fold has local Jacobian one but violates the required measure inequality. Global injectivity and the original cell weights are indispensable.

C9000152.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 152 (Zero entropy does not guarantee a smooth positive-volume model.; papers: A zero-entropy system without a smooth positive-volume model; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/152.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C152_MAIN.statement: The staged thm:main: an ergodic invertible standard nonatomic zero-entropy system has no compact finite-dimensional smooth positive-density diffeomorphism model.

C152_STATIONARY.statement: The dyadic chord estimate and good finite frame segments give b_k >= 2^(-k/10), sum b_k^2 < infinity and compact good base sets of arbitrarily high measure.

C152_LINEAR.statement: Good triangular segments admit all-subinterval signed exterior estimates and separated invariant slow-fast spaces with exp(Cbn) oblique gauge costs.

C152_BIN.statement: Every starting bin has a common separated threshold and reference spaces; common endpoint bins give uniformly invertible fixed endpoint projections.

C152_RELATIVE.statement: All-subinterval exterior bounds imply signed relative perturbation bounds for nearby long products, including exterior degree zero.

C152_ORBITS.statement: The boundary inverse constructs complementary sharp orbit joins, unique in the larger delta tube, retaining product-cell and endpoint-bin margins, including empty groups and boundary.

C152_JACOBIAN.statement: The four endpoint maps are nonsingular and the joint switch has density Jacobian 1+o(1), with independent signed rates and oblique-basis factors cancelling.

C152_INJECTIVE.statement: Output margins recover all labels; boundary uniqueness gives global injectivity and countably many Borel smooth local pieces.

C152_VOLUME.statement: For the actual Section 04 construction and all sufficiently large k, Phi_*(rho_k restricted to G_k) <= 2 rho_k, without normalization and without global multiplicity.

C152_WEIGHTED_VOLUME.statement: A globally injective Borel map covered by C1 local diffeomorphism pieces, with continuous positive input/output densities and density Jacobian at least j>0, pushes the restricted input measure to at most j^(-1) times output measure.

C152_HOLDER_CORE.statement: For every fixed 0<alpha<=1, a compact C^{1,alpha} diffeomorphism preserving a continuous positive density admits the Section 04 finite-bin complementary switch with high-measure retention, sharp orbit tubes, cell and endpoint margins, globally injective Borel local C1 pieces, and density Jacobian 1+o(1).

C152_HOLDER_SWITCH.statement: The controlled-volume switching theorem, including Phi_*(rho_k restricted to G_k)<=K_k rho_k with K_k tending to one, holds for C^{1,alpha} diffeomorphisms and invariant continuous strictly positive densities on compact smooth manifolds, including smooth boundary.

C152_WORDS.statement: Section 05 supplies hierarchical words with the stated short-window laws, recognition, rates and graph relations.

C152_SYSTEM.statement: Section 06 supplies an ergodic invariant phase-extension measure and proves every invariant measure nonatomic with zero KS entropy.

C152_WINDOWS.statement: Aligned window laws have uniformly high entropy and simultaneous graph relations outside the stated small bad mass.

C152_OBSTRUCTION.statement: Cheap scales, graph independence and symbol matching turn switching into the final incompatible .62 and .912 bounds.
